reports.title: AEVEX Corp. Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter 2026

guidance.heading: Business Outlook for the Full Year 2026
section: The demand environment for affordable, operationally proven autonomous systems remains compelling. Our customers are seeking platforms that can move quickly from development to scaled production and support increasingly collaborative air, surface and subsea missions. The growth and diversification of our core business, together with our funded backlog, total convertible contract ceiling, and expanding pipeline, reinforce our confidence in continued growth while reducing our reliance on any single program or theater.
For the full fiscal year 2026, the Company expects total revenue of between $820.0 million to $840.0 million, and Adjusted EBITDA* between $128.0 million and $132.0 million.

* | See “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” below for an explanation of this measure. The Company is unable to provide a reconciliation for forward-looking outlook of Adjusted EBITDA to net income (loss), the most closely comparable GAAP measure without unreasonable effort, because certain material reconciling items cannot be estimated due to factors outside of the Company’s control and could have a material impact on the reported results. However, the Company estimates depreciation and amortization of approximately $30.0 million and net interest expense of approximately $13.0 million for the year ending December 31, 2026.

desk.headline: Revenue up 56% to $189.7m, well above estimates; 2026 revenue and EBITDA outlook raised
results: Revenue rose 56.5% to $189.7m, led by a 67% jump in Airborne Systems from drone products and support services.
The BlackSea purchase closed on 8 September and created a third segment, Maritime Systems, which added $12.4m of revenue in the quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA rose to $30.8m and the margin widened to 16.2% from 14.6%.
The bottom line swung to a $16.8m net loss (-$0.40 a share) mainly because of a $41.7m tax charge; SG&A also rose by $21m.
Free cash flow for the nine months was $34.6m, against an outflow a year earlier; cash ended at $78.6m.

guidance.summary: AEVEX raised its 2026 outlook: revenue of $820-840m (was $700-720m) and adjusted EBITDA of $128-132m (was $105-111.5m). It gave no 2027 guidance.

points: Bookings in Q3 were $250.2m, almost four times Q1, and company-wide book-to-bill was 1.3.
Revenue tied to Ukraine is expected at about $36.3m in Q4 and then to wind down; the new outlook implies 2026 core revenue of $440-460m.
Maritime Systems is tracking the acquisition plan and is expected to bring about $150m of revenue in 2026, helped by Navy funding to upgrade its small unmanned boats.
Since July the company has announced over $300m of awards, plus an IDIQ contract with a ceiling of nearly $400m.

Besides $444.3m funded backlog, management cited about $1.1bn of awarded but unfunded contracts, of which about $410m is expected to turn into revenue by end-2027; it targets margins in the low-to-mid 20% range over time.

watch: How quickly core (non-Ukraine) revenue replaces Ukraine-related sales as those wind down after Q4.
Integration of BlackSea and conversion of unfunded contracts into funded orders.
Whether US budget delays or continuing resolutions slow new orders, a risk the company flagged.
